problem: External web and LinkedIn/company updates could exist as loose evidence without being guaranteed to enrich the canonical relationship, customer and next-best-action context.
decision: Project verified external relationship evidence into canonical predictive signals and expose one person->company->customer->opportunity/NBA context view before relationship scoring.
prevention_rule: No relevant external relationship signal may terminate as an isolated news/event record. It must retain provenance and, when entity matching is valid, flow into canonical person/company/customer intelligence. External evidence alone never proves buying intent and may not create sensitive personal inferences.
